claims.claim: The TravelRuleAttestation contract is deployed and live on Base Sepolia (chain 84532).
claims.limitation: Proves bytecode is present at the address on Base Sepolia; does not prove any attestation rows have been written yet (the two seed attestations await cre login).

claims.claim: No personal data can be written on-chain — the attestation storage struct holds only a bytes32 commitmentHash (no string fields), so a PII write is structurally unrepresentable.
claims.limitation: Proves the storage layout cannot hold a string (PII) field; the on-chain record holds only a bytes32 commitment hash, two uint8 verdicts, a uint64 timestamp and two bools.

claims.claim: The contract's attestation is guarded by the real non-zero Chainlink CRE KeystoneForwarder on Base Sepolia (read back on-chain).
claims.limitation: Proves the write path is gated by the official Chainlink forwarder; workflow-id binding (diff-2) is a wire-phase hardening still open.
